{{Quote|The strategy employed here must be subtle, yet capable of great devastation at a moment's notice.|Reskik|<ref name="GG2-1" />}}
'''Reskik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Grandeel system/Legends|Grandeel system]] who served as a [[Major/Legends|Major]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|New Order]].

==Biography==
[[Major/Legends|Major]] Reskik was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who grew up on a [[Grandeel fish farm]] before entering the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. Reskik was an unassuming but bright student, but learned he could move ahead by appearing non-threatening and unambitious to his superiors. However, he learned to defend himself and his own territory, and developed a vicious and vindictive streak towards those who wronged him. After several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] working within the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army's]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]], he was assigned his first command; the [[Imperial Salvage Station]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], tasked with recovering wreckage from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]].<ref name="GG2-2" />

Reskik did not flaunt his command,<ref name="GG2-2" /> preferring to keep the true nature of his assignment hidden. While the salvage operation remained highly visible, the major kept his military contingent hidden.<ref name="GG2-1" /> The knowledge that he could enforce Imperial rule in the system was enough for Reskik, and he believed that a hands-off approach would keep his workers more productive,<ref name="GG2-2" /> as well increasing the possibility that unwary members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] might fall into his clutches.<ref name="GG2-1" />

==Personality and traits==
Reskik was a bull-necked, slightly overweight man with [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair.<ref name="GG2-2" /> Although unimposing, his ruthless personality was evident after a few minutes spent in his company. However, Reskik was fair, and could be accommodating to others if he felt that he was going to win. However, if crossed, he would stop at nothing to exact revenge.<ref name="GG2-1" />

==Skills and abilities==
Reskik was trained to use a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and was skilled in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. He was knowledgeable about bureaucratic procedure and business practices, and was well versed in [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] techniques, especially those relating to Imperial law. Reskik was an able commander and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Equipment==
Reskik worn an Imperial uniform, carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and was armed with a blaster.<ref name="GG2-1" />
